tagline_en: Cooling gel mask that calms, hydrates and steadies skin
tagline_zh: 降温舒缓 · 镇定补水 · 稳定肤况
overview_en: An improved formula of cucumber, algae and aloe vera extracts that delivers multi-layer hydration and soothing; it rapidly cools, calms and hydrates — ideal for sensitive, inflamed, congestion-prone and unstable skin.
overview_zh: 融合黄瓜、海藻与芦荟等植萃的升级配方，快速为肌肤降温、舒缓与补水；特别适合敏感、发炎、易堵塞与不稳定肌肤，先让皮肤稳定下来，后续精华修复品才能更好渗透，效果加倍。
benefits_en: Preps skin so later steps absorb better
benefits_zh: 稳定肌肤，提升后续吸收
claims_flagged: 特别适合敏感、发炎、容易堵塞和不稳定的皮肤
对于有炎症、痘印的顾客，也能更快地淡化
